name: Substack
description: Trigger workflows from new posts on a Substack publication, and read, search, like, restack and comment on posts, post and read Notes, or save and update a draft with pictures from a step.

triggers.label: New post
triggers.description: A post appears in the publication's RSS feed. Reading the feed needs no sign-in; it holds about the last twenty posts, so a burst larger than that between polls loses the oldest.

env.name: SUBSTACK_PUBLICATION
env.description: Your publication's substack.com subdomain, such as exampleletter. The new-post trigger reads its feed, and a step that names no publication uses it.
env.builderHint: The part before .substack.com in the publication address; a custom domain works for reading only.

actions.label: Read feed
actions.description: The newest posts of any publication from its RSS feed, up to 20, with each body as text and HTML. Needs no sign-in.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: Its substack.com subdomain or address; the connection's publication when empty.

inputs.label: Posts
inputs.description: How many of the newest posts, from 1 to 20; 10 when empty.

outputs.description: The host the feed was read from
How many posts came back, in `posts`

actions.label: Search posts
actions.description: Posts across Substack matching a query, a page at a time, as Substack search ranks them. Needs no sign-in.

inputs.label: Query
inputs.description: Words to search posts for.

inputs.label: Page
inputs.description: Which page of results, from 0; 0 when empty.

outputs.description: How many posts are on this page, in `posts`

actions.label: Read comments
actions.description: Every comment on a post, newest first, with replies after the comment they answer. Needs no sign-in for a public post.

inputs.label: Post
inputs.description: The post's address, or its slug on the publication; not needed when its id is given.

inputs.label: Post id
inputs.description: The post's id, as Search posts returns it; saves looking the post up by address.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: Its substack.com subdomain or address; the connection's publication when empty.

outputs.description: How many comments came back, in `comments`

actions.label: List posts
actions.description: A publication's archive, newest first, up to 500 posts, where the feed holds only the last twenty. Needs no sign-in.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: Its substack.com subdomain or address; the connection's publication when empty.

inputs.label: Posts
inputs.description: How many of the newest posts, from 1 to 500; 50 when empty.

outputs.description: The host the archive was read from
How many posts came back, in `posts`

actions.label: Get post
actions.description: One post with its whole body as HTML and as text, and its likes and restacks. Needs no sign-in for a public post.

inputs.label: Post
inputs.description: The post's address, or its slug on the publication.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: Its substack.com subdomain or address; the connection's publication when empty.

actions.label: Save draft
actions.description: Save a new draft on your publication from a title and markdown, for you to review and publish in Substack. It never publishes, since publishing emails every subscriber.

inputs.label: Title
inputs.description: The draft's title.

inputs.label: Subtitle
inputs.description: The line under the title.

inputs.label: Body
inputs.description: The post in markdown: headings, lists, quotes, code, links and emphasis carry over.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: Its substack.com subdomain; the connection's publication when empty, else the account's primary one.

outputs.description: Where to open the draft in the Substack editor

actions.label: Update draft
actions.description: Replace a draft's title, subtitle and body with new markdown. A published post is refused, and it never publishes.

inputs.label: Draft id
inputs.description: The id Save draft returned.

inputs.label: Title
inputs.description: The draft's title.

inputs.label: Subtitle
inputs.description: The line under the title; empty leaves the draft without one.

inputs.label: Body
inputs.description: The whole post in markdown, replacing what the draft held.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: Its substack.com subdomain; the connection's publication when empty, else the account's primary one.

outputs.description: Where to open the draft in the Substack editor

actions.label: Save or update draft
actions.description: Update the draft a step names, or save a new one when it names none or that draft has since been deleted or published, from a title and markdown with an optional cover picture. Run again with the id it returned, it updates the same draft. It never publishes.

inputs.label: Draft id
inputs.description: The id this action returned before; empty or 0 saves a new draft.
inputs.builderHint: Keep the id from the first run somewhere a later run can read it, so reruns update one draft.

inputs.label: Title
inputs.description: The draft's title.

inputs.label: Subtitle
inputs.description: The line under the title; empty leaves the draft without one.

inputs.label: Body
inputs.description: The whole post in markdown. A line holding only a picture Upload image returned, as ![alt](address), becomes a picture in the post.

inputs.label: Cover picture
inputs.description: A picture's address, as Upload image returns it: the post's cover, shown in previews and on social sites. Empty leaves the cover as it is.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: Its substack.com subdomain; the connection's publication when empty, else the account's primary one.

outputs.description: The draft's id, to hand the next run
Where to open the draft in the Substack editor
Whether a new draft was saved rather than one updated

actions.label: Delete draft
actions.description: Delete a draft on your publication. A published post is refused, so this never removes one.

inputs.label: Draft id
inputs.description: The id Save draft returned.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: Its substack.com subdomain; the connection's publication when empty, else the account's primary one.

actions.label: Upload image
actions.description: Upload a JPEG or PNG from this computer to Substack's picture storage, for a draft's body or cover. It appears nowhere until a draft uses it.

inputs.label: Picture file
inputs.description: A JPEG or PNG, as an absolute path or one starting with ~/, of at most about 730 KB.
inputs.builderHint: Shrink a larger picture first, for example with sips on macOS; a relative path is refused.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: Its substack.com subdomain; the connection's publication when empty, else the account's primary one.

outputs.description: The picture's address, for Save or update draft

actions.label: Comment on post
actions.description: Post a comment on a post as the signed-in account.

inputs.label: Post
inputs.description: The post's address, or its slug on the publication; not needed when its id is given.

inputs.label: Post id
inputs.description: The post's id, as Search posts returns it; saves looking the post up by address.

inputs.label: Comment
inputs.description: The comment, as plain text.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: The publication a post given by slug is on, as its substack.com subdomain or address; the connection's publication when empty.

actions.label: Like or unlike comment
actions.description: Like a comment as the signed-in account, or take the like back. Setting the same state twice changes nothing.

inputs.label: Comment id
inputs.description: The id Read comments returned.

inputs.label: Liked
inputs.description: true to like it, false to take the like back.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: The publication the comment's post is on; the connection's when empty, else the account's primary one.

actions.label: Delete comment
actions.description: Delete one of the signed-in account's comments, or one on its own publication.

inputs.label: Comment id
inputs.description: The id Read comments or Comment on post returned.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: The publication the comment's post is on; the connection's when empty, else the account's primary one.

actions.label: Like or unlike post
actions.description: Like a post as the signed-in account, or take the like back.

inputs.label: Post
inputs.description: The post's address, or its slug on the publication; not needed when its id is given.

inputs.label: Post id
inputs.description: The post's id, as Search posts returns it; saves looking the post up by address.

inputs.label: Liked
inputs.description: true to like it, false to take the like back.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: The publication a post given by slug is on, as its substack.com subdomain or address; the connection's publication when empty.

actions.label: Restack or undo restack post
actions.description: Restack a post to the signed-in account's followers, or take the restack back. Posts only, not Notes.

inputs.label: Post
inputs.description: The post's address, or its slug on the publication; not needed when its id is given.

inputs.label: Post id
inputs.description: The post's id, as Search posts returns it; saves looking the post up by address.

inputs.label: Restacked
inputs.description: true to restack it, false to take the restack back.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: The publication a post given by slug is on, as its substack.com subdomain or address; the connection's publication when empty.

actions.label: Post a note
actions.description: Post a Note as the signed-in account. Followers see it in their feeds as soon as it posts; Delete note takes it down.

inputs.label: Note
inputs.description: The Note in markdown, converted the way a draft's body is.

inputs.label: Link card
inputs.description: An https address to show as a preview card under the Note, the card Substack's composer makes from a pasted link; it is not added to the text.
inputs.builderHint: Leave the address out of the Note's text when it goes here, or it shows twice.

actions.label: Read notes
actions.description: A profile's Notes, newest first, up to 100, from its activity feed as the signed-in account sees it.

inputs.label: Profile
inputs.description: A Substack handle, with or without @; the signed-in account when empty.

inputs.label: Notes
inputs.description: How many of the newest Notes, from 1 to 100; 20 when empty.

outputs.description: The handle the Notes are from
How many Notes came back, in `notes`

actions.label: Delete note
actions.description: Delete one of the signed-in account's Notes.

inputs.label: Note id
inputs.description: The id Post a note or Read notes returned.

actions.label: Read subscriber count
actions.description: Your publication's subscriber, email and view figures, as its dashboard shows them. Needs the signed-in account to run the publication.

inputs.label: Publication
inputs.description: Its substack.com subdomain; the connection's publication when empty, else the account's primary one.

outputs.description: Every subscriber, free and paid: the count the dashboard's subscribers page shows
The dashboard summary’s app subscriber figure
Email open rate, as the dashboard summary reports it
